spec_match.rationale: The five rows map one-to-one onto the gating change's truth table (same-origin, CORS+TAO, TAO-only opaque, CORS-only, neither), with the two regime discriminators drawn straight from the chromestatus summary semantics including the transferSize dual-gate.

interactive.rationale: One run button performs five real fetches row by row, rendering live byte counts, the CORS-gated responseStatus precedent column, and a computed regime verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises regime detection from real fetches with per-row header documentation; exactly what renders.

edge_cases.rationale: Per-row fetch-failure cells carry the real error and exclude the row from the verdict; control-row failure blocks any regime call; both-exposed and both-hidden anomaly branches are named rather than forced into a regime; opaque bodies read defensively.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5195340595724288, resource-timing#220, and documents each endpoint's curl-verified headers in-row and in the feature research record.

conformance.rationale: The suite's discriminator assertions (cors-without-TAO exposes, TAO-only-opaque hides, transferSize needs both) encode the same contracts; on 141 they fail honestly in exact agreement with the page's measured 'tao' regime verdict.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP driver on live network, fresh after the entry-name fix: 5/5 fetches produced entries (same-origin 28,381; CORS+TAO 11,051; TAO-only opaque 11,051 exposed; CORS-only 0; neither 0) and the verdict correctly read the OLD TAO regime; zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow desktop and the mobile run clean. Both regime outcomes are reachable by design, and the one this build exhibits was observed end to end.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the same-origin control exposure every run and records the detected regime with per-row byte counts; row failures are data, not thrown noise.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; exposed/hidden cells emerald/rose with text qualifiers; discriminator rows flagged with a blue edge plus the legend text; verdict colour pairs stay on paper/stone (AA).

accessibility.rationale: Semantic table with caption, scoped column and row headers, labelled scrollable region, discriminators marked in text via the legend (not colour alone), single polite output narrates progress and completion.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The wide table scrolls inside its labelled wrapper (sticky header) so the page itself has 0px overflow at 360px; harness ok/ok with clean console on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the NEW-regime verdict on a Chrome 158 / flag-enabled build
openQuestions.detail: Run the matrix with --enable-blink-features=ResourceTimingUseCORSForBodySizes (or on Chrome 158): the TAO-only row should drop to 0, the CORS-only row should expose encoded/decoded with transferSize 0, and the verdict should flip to the new-rule branch including the dual-gate confirmation sentence.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table narrow mobile viewport without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep the semantic table; wrap it in an overflow-auto container with sticky headers rather than squeezing columns illegibly.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: 46rem min-width table inside .table-wrapper overflow:auto with sticky thead and a tabindex-ed labelled region; page overflow 0px at 360px while the table scrolls internally.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible async multi-row result loading announcements
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce per meaningful milestone through one polite region; render partial results progressively.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Rows render as each fetch settles; the single polite output announces which endpoint is fetching and the final regime summary.

summary: Five real fetches that let the running browser testify which body-size gate it implements. Verified fresh after the final edit with the repo headless-Chromium-141 CDP driver on live network (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this container): 5/5 entries, correct OLD-regime verdict from the two discriminators, clean console/network, ok/ok responsive matrix.
